description: Is there a terror threat, how bad is crime, and which local laws catch visitors out? Returns the FCDO 'Safety and security' section for one country as headed plain-text subsections: terrorism, protests, crime and scams, laws and cultural differences, outdoor activities and transport risks. Live from the GOV.UK Content API. Region-by-region detail for some countries sits in a separate 'Regional risks' section; this tool does not return its text, but gives its link in also_see when it exists. (cost: 1 credit)

country.description: string, required, country name, alternative name (city, island) or GOV.UK slug, e.g. "france"

name: travel_advice_safety
